```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the United States should defend freedom of the press.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Independent media is not the enemy of the people, but the guardian of democracy.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will push back against erosion of press freedom wherever it occurs and in whatever form—whether through direct intimidation of, and violence against, journalists or legal, regulatory, and financial pressures that smother free speech.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight human trafficking and strive to end the practice of modern-day slavery around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will aggressively leverage U.S. law enforcement and strengthen diplomatic efforts to combat forced labor and commercial sexual exploitation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase visas for victims of human trafficking at a time when mass migration has affected so many vulnerable communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe improving labor standards around the world protects human rights and promotes broad-based prosperity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that America's diplomatic and trade agreements include enforcement provisions for workers' rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to end poverty-wage, child, and slave labor.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe American workers should not be undercut by foreign competition that relies on the abuse of workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support the rights of unions and workers abroad to organize, including International Labor Organization Conventions supporting freedom of association and collective bargaining.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
